title: Sources: the US DOJ is investigating Iran's use of Binance to evade sanctions, focusing on money flowing to networks backing terror groups like Yemen's Houthis (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: the US DOJ is investigating Iran's use of Binance to evade sanctions, focusing on money flowing to networks backing terror groups like Yemen's Houthis — Investigation focuses on money flowing through crypto platform to network backing terror groups, including Yemen's Houthi militants
